About Apex Travels

Journeys Beyond Expectations.

Apex Travels is a Maharashtra-based travel and transportation company focused on creating comfortable, reliable and modern journeys for individuals, families, groups and businesses.

From airport transfers and corporate travel to outstation journeys and city travel, Apex Travels makes getting where you need to go simple.

Every journey starts with renting the Limo Green — our all-electric 7-seater — so you can travel at your own pace, anywhere in India.
